description: Hash text with MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, CRC32, Whirlpool, SHA3-256, SHA3-512, BLAKE2b-256 or BLAKE3 and answer the digest in hex, or for crc32 as an integer. Use sha256, sha3_256, blake2b or blake3 for integrity checks; md5 and sha1 are for systems that still expect them. argon2id, bcrypt and scrypt are password hashes: slow by design, salted, answered as a self-describing string, limited to 200 calls per day, and meant for test data, since a real password should be hashed where it is used. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.
name: hash_data
title: Hash text
